objs.name: document
objs.description: A controlled artifact subject to creation, editing, review, approval, and archival within the P&R Management system. Documents are versioned and subject to release cycles and validity periods.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document attachment that is automatically released with the main document and has its own versioning. Modifications to attachments trigger new versions of the main document.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: A document supplement that is not subject to the main document's release cycle and does not trigger new versions when created, modified, or deleted.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A planned amendment to an existing document that is tracked separately without affecting the document's content or version history until implemented.

objs.name: user
objs.description: A person with defined roles and authorizations in the P&R Management system, including author, reviewer, releaser, reader, and translator capabilities.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A collection of users grouped together for the purpose of assigning authorizations and distribution rights to documents.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: A classification category for documents (e.g., Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, Work Instruction) with associated templates and archive periods.

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: An automatically generated system request created 30 days before a document's validity expiration date, requiring workflow-supported review and decision.

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request created to declare a document invalid and archive it when it has no additional validity and must be withdrawn from circulation.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to re-validate and restore an archived document to active status during the archiving period.

objs.name: document_version
objs.description: A released or editing state instance of a document, tracked through the versioning system with associated status and validity dates.

objs.name: signature
objs.description: An electronic signature applied by workflow participants (author, reviewer, releaser, translator) to document a completed workflow task.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of user groups and persons assigned to receive email notifications or confirmation requests when a document version is released.

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: A special user group that retains read access to archived documents after all other authorizations are revoked.

objs.name: template
objs.description: A predefined document structure associated with a document type, enabling automatic insertion of metadata via TAG technology.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: A business division or department to which documents can be linked for process-specific filing.

objs.name: process
objs.description: A business sequence to which documents can be linked for reference and control.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: A business risk item to which documents can be linked as reference material.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: A software system that can be referenced by documents as an applicable system or context.

objs.name: scope
objs.description: A metadata attribute indicating the area of validity or applicability of a document.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Reference information (e.g., companies, locations, business areas) maintained as metadata on documents.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: A translation of a released document into an alternative language, subject to its own review and release workflow.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Initial creation of a document in the system by attaching a new information object and selecting a document type and template.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Modification of a document's content using the integrated editing client in MS Office formats or direct PDF editing.

evts.name: maintain_document_properties
evts.description: Addition or modification of document metadata and attributes such as references, IT applications, validity scope, and master data.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Definition of user-level and group-level read and change permissions for documents, attachments, and related objects.

attributes.name: authorization_level
attributes.description: The type of permission granted (read, write, etc.)

evts.name: submit_document_for_review
evts.description: Initiation of the 3-step release workflow (Creator-Review-Release) by the author or co-author.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Technical and formal assessment of document content and properties by assigned reviewers.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Final approval and publication of a document by assigned releasers, making it visible to designated readers.

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Application of electronic signature by a workflow participant (author, reviewer, or releaser) to complete a workflow task.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatic distribution and visibility of a released document to all assigned readers and user groups.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Submission of a planned amendment to an existing document without modifying the original content or version history.

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: Integration of an approved change proposal into a new version of the document.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Modification of released document content or properties, resulting in creation of a new version in editing status.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Marking of an attachment as archived during document revision when it is no longer relevant to the new version.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: Automatic system generation of a validity review request 30 days before a document's validity expiration date.

evts.name: extend_document_validity
evts.description: Confirmation by appropriate participants that a document remains valid and renewal of its validity period.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: User submission of a request to declare a document invalid and archive it due to loss of validity.

evts.name: declare_override
evts.description: Formal invalidation of a document and revocation of all user authorizations except for the archive group, followed by archiving.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Submission by authorized users to re-validate and restore a previously archived document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Confirmation and restoration of an archived document to active status with retained metadata and reactivated attachments.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Creation of a language-specific version of a released document for display to users in alternative login languages.

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Technical and formal assessment of a translated document's content and properties.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Final approval of a translated document version, making it visible to authorized readers in the target language.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Automatic email notification of document release to assigned users and user groups without requiring acknowledgement.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatic workflow-supported request for users to actively confirm receipt and understanding of a released document.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Workflow task completion by a recipient confirming awareness and acceptance of a released document.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatic system conversion of edited document content to PDF format for web display.

evts.name: link_document_to_master_data
evts.description: Association of a document with processes, organizational units, risks, IT applications, or other reference objects.
